_comment: Every cost curve. Same rule as sim/: no economy number is hardcoded, because a live F2P game retunes prices without shipping a client.
_levels: Scrap cost compounds per level, so a wide shallow collection stays a real alternative to one maxed part.
_refit: Duplicates are the gate; alloy is the tax. This is the sink that makes pulling a duplicate feel like progress instead of a wasted crate.
_faucets: Kept next to the sinks on purpose, so the two can be read against each other.
